hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in "$HOME/.claude/"*) git -C "$HOME/.claude" add -A 2>/dev/null; git -C "$HOME/.claude" diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null || git -C "$HOME/.claude" commit -q -m "auto: config change ($(basename "$fp"))" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; exit 0

statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir_basename=$(basename "$current_dir"); remaining=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); git_branch=""; if git -C "$current_dir" rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1; then git_branch=$(git -C "$current_dir" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$git_branch" ] && git_branch="($git_branch)"; fi; components=(); [ -n "$git_branch" ] && components+=("$git_branch"); [ -n "$model" ] && components+=("$model"); [ -n "$dir_basename" ] && components+=("$dir_basename"); [ -n "$remaining" ] && components+=("ctx: $(printf '%.0f%%' "$remaining")"); IFS=" | "; echo "${components[*]}"
